verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers automations such as custom categorization rules and AI tasks, so this axis applies. However, the evidence does not document versioning, version review, or rollback of those automations. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: review of automation outputs before they are final, MCP write-access confirmations, and reversing journal entries when a manual entry is edited. None of these is version history or rollback for the automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
